description: This file defines the WorkflowCollectionEditor class, which is a property editor used for converting between string representations and collections of ProgramWorkflow objects within the OpenMRS healthcare data platform. It is responsible for parsing text input to update workflows and serializing workflows back into a string format, facilitating UI data binding and configuration.

classes.name: WorkflowCollectionEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting string representations of program workflows into actual ProgramWorkflow objects and vice versa. It supports updating workflows for a given program based on a specially formatted string, and generating string representations for display or persistence.

methods.name: WorkflowCollectionEditor
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Program object to initialize the editor for specific program workflows.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Parses a string of the format 'program_id:concept_id concept_id ...' to update the set of ProgramWorkflow objects accordingly.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Serializes the current collection of ProgramWorkflow objects into a space-separated string of concept IDs prefixed with program ID.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a string input into a collection of ProgramWorkflow objects associated with a program. It updates or creates workflows based on concept IDs provided in the input string.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the collection of workflows, showing program ID and concept IDs.
